findings.current: The words *death* and *death* flashed through my mind, but no.
findings.defect: The draft mechanically renders the two written syllables of 죽음 as two repetitions of the English word, producing nonsense.
findings.rationale: 두 글자 describes the written form of the single Korean word 죽음; it does not repeat the concept twice.
findings.replacement: The word *death* flashed through my mind, but no.
findings.source: 죽음이라는 두 글자가 뇌리를 스쳤지만, 아니다.

findings.current: My body shot forward like a cannonball, creating a small crater as I crossed more than twenty yards in one bound.
findings.defect: The draft treats 장 as a yard, reducing the distance to roughly one-third of the source quantity.
findings.rationale: Twenty-odd 장 is approximately sixty-plus yards, not twenty yards.
findings.replacement: My body shot forward like a cannonball, creating a small crater as I crossed more than sixty yards in one bound.
findings.source: 작은 크레이터를 만들며 포탄처럼 쏘아진 신형이 단번에 이십여 장에 달하는 공간을 뛰어넘었다.

findings.current: The answer to my question was a single flash of light that glinted from more than ten yards away.
findings.defect: The draft again treats 장 as a yard, substantially shortening the attack's range.
findings.rationale: Ten-odd 장 is approximately thirty-plus yards.
findings.replacement: The answer to my question was a single flash of light that glinted from more than thirty yards away.
findings.source: 그리고 내 물음에 돌아온 대답은, 십여 장 너머에서 번뜩인 한 줄기의 섬광이었다.

findings.current: Before careless mercy brought about an even greater disaster, I had to cut off his breath right here.
findings.defect: The draft adds mercy as Jin's motive, although the source refers more broadly to using inadequate or half-hearted measures.
findings.rationale: 어설픈 손속 means insufficient or sloppy handling; it does not state that Jin is showing mercy.
findings.replacement: Before half measures brought about an even greater disaster, I had to snuff out his life right here.
findings.source: 어설픈 손속으로 더 큰 화를 부르기 전에, 반드시 이 자리에서 숨통을 끊어야 한다.

findings.current: The present me had been given only the briefest instant in which to choose.
findings.defect: “The present me” is an unnatural Korean-syntax calque in otherwise contemporary first-person narration.
findings.rationale: 지금의 내게 means Jin in his present circumstances, naturally expressed here as a direct statement about the time available to him.
findings.replacement: I had only the briefest instant to make my choice.
findings.source: 지금의 내게는 선택을 위한 아주 짧은 찰나의 순간만이 주어졌을 뿐이다.

findings.current: I stared at the twin wheel clutched in my left hand and slowly turned around.
findings.defect: The draft makes the paired weapon singular, contradicting 쌍륜 and the two streaks of light he intercepted.
findings.rationale: 쌍륜 denotes a pair of wheels, not one “twin wheel.”
findings.replacement: I stared at the twin wheels clutched in my left hand and slowly turned around.
findings.source: 왼손에 붙잡힌 쌍륜(雙輪)을 응시하던 나는 천천히 몸을 돌렸다.

findings.current: Then a flashing streak of light crossed more than twenty yards and charged at me.
findings.defect: The draft once more converts 장 directly into yards, reducing the projectile's travel distance by roughly two-thirds.
findings.rationale: Twenty-odd 장 is approximately sixty-plus yards.
findings.replacement: Then a flashing streak of light crossed more than sixty yards and hurtled at me.
findings.source: 뒤이어 번뜩이는 섬광이 이십여 장의 공간을 가로지르며 쇄도했다.

findings.current: I caught the streak of light with one hand, reinforcing it with all my internal energy, and fell silent.
findings.defect: The pronoun makes Jin reinforce the incoming projectile with his internal energy, reversing the source mechanism; he charges his hand before catching it.
findings.rationale: 한껏 공력을 실은 modifies 손: Jin fills his catching hand with internal energy rather than adding energy to the projectile.
findings.replacement: I caught the streak of light with a hand packed with internal energy and fell silent.
findings.source: 한껏 공력을 실은 손으로 섬광을 잡아챈 나는 입을 다물었다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity errors, chiefly incorrect distance conversions, an added motive of mercy, a singularized paired weapon, and a reversed energy-action mechanism.
